summary: Real-time planning poker for refinement sessions: open a link, share the room, estimate. No account.
decisions: PartyKit keeps every participant's vote in sync over WebSockets.
Rooms live in memory at the edge: no database, and nothing to clean up after a session.
No accounts, by design: a shared link is the whole onboarding.
Installable as a PWA, for a phone in a stand-up.
